blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Unemployment in the country eased for the first time in three months to 5.3 percent in August, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) said on Wednesday. The latest print marked an improvement from the four-year high of 6 percent recorded in July, equivalent to 2.77 million jobless Filipinos, down from 3.14 million the previous month. READ: Jobless rate rises to 4-year high of 6% in July This came as the employment rate rose to 94.7 percent during the month from 94 percent, bringing the number of employed Filipinos to 49.79 million from 49.21 million.
